subject: Eval acceptance criteria, showcase scripts, and fail‑fast checkpoints
messages:
From: Rahul Mehta <rahul@carebridge.health>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Gomez <sofia.gomez@carebridge.health>
Date: 2026-08-28T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff & MAP scope

Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick intro call today. As discussed, our execs want a short, unambiguous acceptance plan for the 6‑week evaluation so they can greenlight resources. Can you send a MAP that lists: the success criteria, the demos we should run for the board showcase, the fail‑fast checkpoints, and any minimal acceptance tests your team will run?

High level constraints: production like data (PHI redacted), <150ms 95p latency for short responses, and concordance on our 150 prompt set >= 85%. Also need a timeline that ties to procurement signoff (we expect procurement review on week 5).

— Rahul
Head of Clinical Ops, CareBridge Health
rahul@carebridge.health
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Rahul Mehta <rahul@carebridge.health>
Cc: Sofia Gomez <sofia.gomez@carebridge.health>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-28T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff & MAP scope

Rahul —

Appreciate the clear ask. Attached is a first‑pass MAP and a lightweight smoke test checklist (PDF + spreadsheet). Key callouts in the MAP:

• Success criteria (primary):
  - Functional concordance: >=85% top‑1 alignment on the 150 prompt specimen set across the 6‑week window.
  - Latency SLO: 95th percentile <150ms for <256 token responses under your expected load profile.
  - Cost guardrail: average per‑1k tokens cost not exceed the baseline we agreed on in the call (see deal note).

• Exit gates (hard):
  - Concordance <70% on any critical workflow → automatic stop and review.
  - Persistent 95p latency >300ms for two consecutive days under normal traffic → pause.

• Acceptance tests we will run (high level):
  - Functional smoke suite (attached): 150 prompts run daily; diff + human spot check for drift.
  - Safety sample: 50 edge prompts verified by your clinical reviewer weekly.
  - Load probe: 10k requests over 10 minutes at expected burst profile to validate batching behavior and caching.

• Showcase/demo scripts: three short flows we recommend for the board demo — triage example (end‑to‑end), clinician note summarization, and a reranking/clarity prompt. I included markdown scripts for the presenter.

• Timeline: Week 0 (kickoff) — baseline tests & dataset upload; Week 1–4 — daily automated runs + weekly sync; Week 5 — procurement & exec dry run; Week 6 — final signoff. We annotate gating tasks so procurement artifacts line up with your review.

I pasted the most relevant excerpt from the MAP below, and attached the full doc. If this aligns, Ben and I will add the technical acceptance scripts and a quick runbook for your oncall.

Excerpt (from MAP):
- Gate A (Week 2): Baseline concordance >=75% AND no critical latency degradations.
- Gate B (Week 4): Concordance trending upward, automated smoke tests stable >=80%, procurement checklist started.
- Gate C (Week 6): Final concordance >=85%, exec dry run completed, legal/procurement approvals in place.

Next steps: tell us if procurement needs extra artifacts (SOC/SR) earlier; otherwise we’ll lock the MAP and drop the test artifacts in the shared Drive.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Rahul Mehta <rahul@carebridge.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff & MAP scope (technical acceptance tests)

On Mon, Aug 28, 2026 at 11:02 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com> wrote:
> I pasted the most relevant excerpt from the MAP below...

Rahul / Kim —

I sketched the technical acceptance scripts we’ll run and added a few measurable pass/fail thresholds. Short version: everything is automated (we’ll drop CI jobs into the Drive). Highlights:

1) Concordance harness (daily): run 150 prompts, compute top‑1 match vs your golden labels, and produce per‑intent breakdown. Pass if overall >=85% and no single critical intent <70%.

2) Latency probe: synthetic probe mimicking your median request size. Pass if 95p <150ms; fail and auto‑alert if 95p >250ms for 2 consecutive runs.

3) Resource/kv cache test: validate KV cache warmup behavior with cold→warm sequence; ensure y‑token reuse reduces compute by >20% for repeated context.

4) Cost sanity: run synthetic 24h model mix (default + quantized) and estimate per‑1k token spend; if estimate exceeds threshold, flag for config change and rollback to cheaper variant.

5) Failure mode samples: when a test fails we automatically snapshot inputs/outputs + trace IDs for triage. We’ll provide the triage playbook and the short demo script for the exec dry run.

I attached the smoke checklist spreadsheet; Kimberly — if you want, I’ll convert the concordance harness output to a single dashboard widget for your weekly sync.

— Ben
Principal Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Rahul Mehta <rahul@carebridge.health>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Gomez <sofia.gomez@carebridge.health>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff & MAP scope (acceptance tests)

Ben / Kim —

This looks great and very actionable. A couple of asks before we lock: 
1) Can you add a short matrix that maps each of our five clinical workflows to the 150 prompt set so execs can see coverage?
2) For the latency probe, can you show expected results under an on‑call traffic spike (we typically see 3x normal for 15 minutes)?
3) Procurement asked for an artifacts list for week 5 (licenses, SOC pointer, sample contract language).

We’ll review the attachments and share the golden labels for the concordance harness by EOD Tuesday. If those align, we can lock the MAP and schedule the exec dry run for Day 34 (week 5).

— Rahul
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Rahul Mehta <rahul@carebridge.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff & MAP scope (finalized next steps)

Rahul —

Thanks — we’ll add the coverage matrix and the 3x spike probe results to the shared Drive by tomorrow morning. Procurement artifacts: I’ll have Marissa attach the SOC pointer + sample contract language and a one‑page procurement checklist (week 5).

Plan to lock the MAP once we ingest your golden labels (EOD Tue). After lock: we’ll start daily concordance runs, drop the dashboard widget, and reserve a 60‑minute exec dry run slot on week 5 — I’ll propose two times once procurement confirms availability.

If anything urgent pops up ping my cell.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Manager — Redwood Inference
